producers.finding: Ordinary export catch logs and appends AggregateError only; only interruption writes an unbound single export-rejection.json.
Throws actual native/evidence/review admission errors; verified.review.json retains actual independent grade.

consumers.finding: outcomes falls back to raw Native execution/test error; those are null when native testpassed but export/review rejects.
Consume outcomes entries; diagnostic fix must not change acceptance, teacher exposure or classification of actual model action failures.
Pending review remains interrupted/deferred, not fabricated testfailure; genuine completed/partial manifests remain authoritative.

design: Append per-run source/raw-hash-bound export failure records on all real exporter exceptions. Python outcome reader uses only exact matching diagnostic records, preserving malformed/stale diagnostics separately and original raw/test proof. Do not reclassify native passed+reviewrejected as native testfailure, or accept a capture because of a diagnostic.
